providers.product: NVIDIA Build hosted public NIM API prototyping, not NGC registry/Enterprise/self-hosted NIM

currentLain.inference: Catalog nvidia-build, OpenAI-compatible Bearer key, https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1

sources.claim: Hosted NVIDIA Build inference, developer login and key creation/copy workflow.
Free hosted prototyping for Developer Program; production license/self-hosted evaluation are separate.
Up to 40 rpm and 10,000 requests per day; model/traffic variation; no usage/remaining/reset/account fields.
Runtime limit display and api.ngc.nvidia.com/login with email, app=api-catalog, redirect_uri.
Session key list/create /v3/orgs/{org}/keys/type/AI_PLAYGROUNDS_KEY; invoke_function policy; no quota read scope.
Browser credential fetch, per-path routing to api.ngc.nvidia.com or buildapi.ngc.nvidia.com.
Personal keys can explicitly include NVIDIA Public API Endpoints; arbitrary registry or cloud function permission insufficient; $oauthtoken is API-key auth.
NCA or SSO membership does not grant NGC roles/service access; Public API Endpoints role separately assigned.
NGC CLI setup uses ngc config set and an existing API key; no qualified browser/device login in this workflow.
